## (3) Attempt numbering trace (the rename scheme)
- Attempt 1 (fresh task): no files. _begin_attempt: numbered=empty, max_num=0, no bare -> return 1. Write bare, attempt=1. Files: [T<id>.json].
- Attempt 2 (re-dispatch): numbered=empty, max_num=0, bare exists -> rename bare -> T<id>.1.json, return 2. Write bare, attempt=2. Files: [T<id>.1.json, T<id>.json].
- Attempt 3: numbered={1}, max_num=1, bare exists -> rename bare -> T<id>.2.json, return 3. Write bare, attempt=3. Files: [T<id>.1.json, T<id>.2.json, T<id>.json].
The archived file's suffix = the attempt number it carried; the bare always = the latest attempt. Every record carries attempt + model fields.
